$comment: Copy to relay.config.json (or point RELAY_CONFIG at a file like this) to run the gateway in routed mode. API keys are NEVER written here: apiKeyEnv names an environment variable the gateway reads at dispatch time. Prices are USD per 1k tokens and feed the cash book (src/ledger.js). Every model carries a capability grade (light|standard|heavy) for the difficulty axis: the router only sends a task to models graded at or above the task's classified level (see docs/DIFFICULTY-REPORT.md). A bare string model entry is still accepted and grades as 'standard'. An upstream may declare quotaSource to pick its quota source: 'codex-usage' reads remaining quota from Codex's official usage endpoint (both windows; the tighter one leads), with the credential taken from the local Codex sign-in (~/.codex/auth.json, or env RELAY_CODEX_AUTH) at fetch time — it is never written into this file. Without quotaSource, the quota block's own source applies ('mock' / 'metering' / 'unavailable'). A 'gemini' upstream speaks Google's Cloud Code protocol (v1internal) with an OAuth credential, never an API key: the credential file is the Gemini CLI-shaped oauth_creds.json at env RELAY_GEMINI_CREDS (default ~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json), read and refreshed by src/gemini-creds.js; baseUrl may override the API base (default https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal), and once the sign-in/onboarding step produces a cloudaicompanion project id it can be pinned on the upstream as "project". Gemini quota stays a metering estimate, honestly labeled - see docs/GEMINI-REPORT.md. A 'gemini' upstream speaks Google's Cloud Code protocol (v1internal) with an OAuth credential — never an API key: the credential file is the Gemini CLI-shaped oauth_creds.json at env RELAY_GEMINI_CREDS (default ~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json), read and refreshed by src/gemini-creds.js; baseUrl may override the API base (default https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal), and after the sign-in/onboarding step produces a cloudaicompanion project id it can be pinned here as "project". Gemini quota stays a metering estimate (honestly labeled) — see docs/GEMINI-REPORT.md.
